description: This Java class models a product review entity within an e-commerce application, including fields for review details, associations with Customer and Product entities, and audit information.

classes.name: ProductReview
classes.description: Entity class representing a product review, including review details, associations with customer and product, and audit fields.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the review.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the review.

methods.name: getReviewRating
methods.description: Returns the rating given in the review.

methods.name: setReviewRating
methods.description: Sets the rating for the review.

methods.name: getReviewRead
methods.description: Returns the number of times the review has been read.

methods.name: setReviewRead
methods.description: Sets the number of times the review has been read.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the review.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the review.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the customer who made the review.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Assigns a customer to the review.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the product associated with the review.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a product with the review.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of review descriptions.

methods.name: getReviewDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the review was made.

methods.name: setReviewDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the review.
